diffusion_admittance.method: Dimensionless exact finite-base admittance Y = sqrt(1+jωτ) coth[(W/L)sqrt(1+jωτ)], compare Im(Y)/(ωτ) to DC stored-charge derivative tanh[W/(2L)]. ωτ=1e-6.
diffusion_admittance.qualification: Independent linear diffusion calculation with zero excess at the far ohmic contact; not a measured universal diode capacitance.

MOS_reference.method: SC.mosSetup p-Si 1e17 cm^-3, tox 5nm, 300K, default n+ poly; direct calls on current semi.js

finite_GaAs_well.method: Extract current qwLevels function from hetero.html, with KQ=5.1231, V0=.23eV, mw=.067m0, mb=.092m0; solve BenDaniel–Duke matching equation

detailed_balance_blackbody.method: Independent Python Planck spectrum integration, sun 5778K normalized to 1000W/m², cell 300K, energy step .004eV; optimize voltage and Eg
detailed_balance_blackbody.qualification: Not AM1.5G; finite energy grid introduces small rounding differences from current JS curve.

metal_semiconductor.method: Browser smoke test with the initial seeded specimen and manual drag of both handles to the least-squares fit. C–V limit sampled at the minimum barrier and doping.

MOS_extraction.method: Generated seed values 5–504 using the page sample generator; estimated Cox and Cmin from three leftmost and ten rightmost capacitance measurements; solved Wmax relation for NA; interpolated the first CFB crossing; quantized to the real UI slider increments before comparing with the generator parameters.
MOS_extraction.qualification: Simulated 1 MHz measurements with the page's assumed uniform doping, small measurement noise and ideal oxide model.

MOSFET_extraction.method: 500 seeded devices in the interactive generator's ranges. Constructed 151 data samples each with 0.5% mean relative noise and a 0.2 pA floor. Picked peak gm of the noisy local fit and the first 0.10 V window starting at or above 2 pA. Compared to the same fit on clean data and the theoretical weak-inversion SS.

CMOS_inverter.method: 150 pairings of 25 supply steps from 0.6 to 1.8 V with six width ratios from 0.5 to 5. Compared each VIL/VIH crossing against implicit differentiation of the current balance, and checked symmetry for device strength ratio 1.

short_channel_barrier.qualification: Barrier energy shift per electron is used as an approximate threshold shift. The simulator omits DIBL extraction when the source barrier is lost.

backscattering.model: One-dimensional directional reversals separated by exponential flight distances, with absorbing source and drain. The current model inserts r = 1−T into (1−r)/(1+r).

bjt.coverage: BJT terminal-current conservation, forward/reverse reciprocity, electrostatic band continuity, positive reverse-active output gain, zero neutral-base width at punch-through.

opto.coverage: Independent depth and spectral quadrature, photocurrent bounds, monotonic terminal I–V and MPP stationarity, detailed-balance power budget, self-heated threshold and Fresnel limiting cases.

rf_full_review.noise_reference: Pure gate-resistor fixture verifies Rn=Rg·300/290 and F=1+(Rg/50)·300/290.
rf_full_review.nqs_check: 12 amplitude/frequency cases. At 0.2 normalized gate drive, f/fT≈0.0316, 1, 3 and 3.98 give drain lags of 0.73°, 22.73°, 63.42° and 80.40°.
rf_full_review.qualification: Educational small-signal and input-referred noise models. The challenge optimizes within its discrete controls and assumes a lossless susceptance adjustment. Johnson plots use representative coordinates for comparison.

reliability_full_review.qualification: Models illustrate contributions and numerical sensitivity. The ESD waveform is an imposed educational pulse, and the lifetime limits and passing window depend on the chosen model inputs.

esd_full_review.qualification: RLC and equivalent-circuit checks validate the specified educational models. They do not establish real tester waveforms, IEC/JEDEC device qualification, or safe circuit design limits.

independent_engine_limits.fermi_method: Direct composite Simpson quadrature after energy substitution t=x², 16384 intervals, eta [-40,-20,-10,-5,-2,0,1,2,5,10,20,40,80,120]; compare normalized F_1/2 integral with approximation.
independent_engine_limits.neutrality_method: Silicon equilibrium at N=1e13,1e15,1e17,1e19; T=100,300,600 K; donor-only and acceptor-only; residual normalized by largest carrier/ion density.
independent_engine_limits.MOS_method: p/n mirror C–V for N=1e15,1e17,1e18; tox=1.5,5,20nm; phims=0; Vg=-3,-1,0,1,3; LF/HF/deep-depletion modes (135 paired conditions, 270 capacitance evaluations), capacitance positive and <=Cox.

inversion_charge.method: High-resolution independent quadrature of q∫(n−n0)dx, using dx=εdψ/|Qs(ψ)|; 3 dopings × 4 surface-potential/phiF ratios × p/n mirror =24 references in regression. Flat-band Debye limit and no inversion in accumulation also checked.
inversion_charge.qualification: Classical, nondegenerate Poisson–Boltzmann model with bulk majority density approximated by doping. Quantum confinement is not included.

illuminated_neutral_slab.method: Equal electron/hole mobilities 1000 cm²/Vs, tau_n=tau_p=1us, uniform G=1e20 cm⁻³s⁻¹, L=.02cm, 401 points, zero bias. Compare n(x)=ni+2Gtau[1−cosh((x−L/2)/sqrt(2Dtau))/cosh(L/(2sqrt(2Dtau)))].
illuminated_neutral_slab.qualification: Validates a controlled analytic limit; does not prove convergence/accuracy at every nonlinear junction operating point.

crystal_numerical_evidence.energy_order_method: 1<=N<=40, d=1.6..6.0 Angstrom in 0.01 steps (17640 cases); compare adjacent interpolated levels before sorting and after sorting. Persistent regression covers 3560 cases at 0.05 Angstrom steps.
crystal_numerical_evidence.geometry: Conventional cells n=1,2 give boundary-weighted 8n³ atoms. Interior sites each have four nearest neighbours at sqrt(3)a/4; pairwise bond direction dot products are -1/3. Planar densities checked for 100,110,111 and empty intermediate slices.
crystal_numerical_evidence.kp_mass_method: P=.1,1,5,20; compare analytic -fprime(x0)/x0 with independently inverted dispersion at kappa=.001. Free-barrier limit m*/m0=1 also checked.
